result: Narrowed to one four-point strict order and four integer matrices. The 2026-10-24 lake build of LocalNetAxiomsImport exited 0. Every printed axiom list is empty, hence a subset of propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound.
proof_boundary: The 64-triple scan holds, there are 3 ordered relations and 3 spacelike unordered pairs, the disjoint-site products equal A tensor B and sum to 260, and the same-site (0,2) entries are -1 and 1. No continuum region index and no Minkowski light cone are constructed. CausalOrder.lean is not imported. The node stays IMPORTED_ASSUMPTION.
